X509::version
Description
Returns the version number of the specified X509 certificate (an
integer).
Syntax
X509
::
version
<
X509
certificate

X509::version <X509 certificate>
Returns the version number of the specified X509 certificate (an
integer).
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
log
local0.
"Cert version - [X509::version ssl_cert]"
if
{
[
X509
::
version
ssl_cert
]
eq
3
}
{
pool
v3_pool
}
else
{
pool
default_pool
}
}
